headline: Names a New Jersey post office in Waldwick after Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1 Walter Hammond Place in Waldwick, New Jersey. The building will be officially called the "Staff Sergeant Joseph D'Augustine Post Office Building." It is a ceremonial change that honors the named person and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 7, 2015, and the name change took effect on that date.
